2609.28272.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning: Learning Causal Shortcuts for Diffusion Language Models
2609.28272.paper_summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have attracted significant attention for their strong reasoning ability. However, under a bidirectional attention mechanism, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space compared to autoregressive models (ARMs), making it challenging to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens under random masking. We define causal shortcuts as token chains that cover the full sequence and provide explicit guidance towards correct reasoning trajectories. We analyze the effects of causal shortcuts on the reasoning accuracy and convergence speed of DLMs, and find that they largely improve answer convergence efficiency and generation accuracy. Motivated by this, we propose a Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. Specifically, we introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data, and apply parallel prioritized masking on these tokens during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and two base models demonstrate that CSL consistently outperforms existing SFT-variant baselines, achieving an average improvement of $1.92\%$ over SFT-only models, and up to $4.20\%$ on MATH-500. The code is available at the \href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning}{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning
2609.28272.paper_summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLMs）因其強大的推理能力而受到廣泛關注。<lb/>然而，在雙向注意機制下，DLMs 的探索空間相比自回歸模型（ARMs）大幅增大，這使得在隨機遮罩下專注於推理引導的標記變得具有挑戰性。<lb/>我們將因果捷徑定義為覆蓋整個序列的標記鏈，並提供明確的指導以朝向正確的推理軌跡。<lb/>我們分析了因果捷徑對 DLMs 的推理準確性和收斂速度的影響，發現它們在很大程度上提高了答案的收斂效率和生成準確性。<lb/>受到此啟發，我們提出了一個針對 DLMs 的因果捷徑學習（CSL）框架。<lb/>具體而言，我們引入了一個逐步的標記提取程序，從數據中提取因果捷徑，並在訓練期間對這些標記應用並行優先遮罩，以便通過因果捷徑有效且準確地收斂到正確答案。<lb/>在多個推理基準和兩個基礎模型上的廣泛實驗表明，CSL 始終優於現有的 SFT 變體基準，平均提高了 $1.92\%$，在 MATH-500 上最高達到 $4.20\%$。<lb/>代碼可在 \href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning}{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning} 獲得。
